story_description: Define the core Swift data models that represent registry items (skills, plugins, agents) with full type safety, Codable conformance, and validation logic for downstream consumption by cache, fetcher, and UI layers.
task_description: Create the foundational Swift structs and enums for parsing and representing registry JSON responses including RegistryResponse, SkillItem, PluginItem, AgentItem, and supporting metadata types.
atom_description: Implement all registry data model types in Blaze/Sources/Registry/Models/RegistryModels.swift including RegistryResponse as the top-level container, SkillItem/PluginItem/AgentItem as Identifiable+Codable domain types, RegistryMetadata for author/license/repository info, RegistryPermissions for tool access requirements, and VersionConstraint for CLI version compatibility. Each type includes computed properties for validation and display formatting.
problem_statement: The Blaze app needs to consume a remote extension registry serving skills, plugins, and agents for multiple CLI tools. Without strongly-typed Swift models, JSON parsing would be ad-hoc and error-prone. The models must handle schema evolution, validate constraints, and provide a clean API for cache storage and UI rendering.
scope_in: RegistryResponse struct with schemaVersion, updatedAt, and arrays of skills/plugins/agents
SkillItem struct with id, name, description, version, forCli, installUrl, metadata, permissions fields
PluginItem struct with id, name, description, version, forCli, installUrl, metadata, permissions, configSchema fields
AgentItem struct with id, name, description, version, forCli, installUrl, metadata, permissions, requiredSkills fields
RegistryMetadata struct with author, license, repositoryUrl, downloadCount, rating, tags fields
RegistryPermissions struct with requiredTools, optionalTools, fileAccess, networkAccess fields
VersionConstraint enum with minVersion, maxVersion, exactVersion cases
Codable and Identifiable protocol conformance for all model types
Custom CodingKeys for snake_case to camelCase mapping
Computed properties for isInstalled, displayVersion, permissionSummary
scope_out: UI views and selection logic (handled by R006/R007/R008)
Registry JSON schema definition (external to app)
assumptions: Registry JSON uses snake_case field names requiring custom CodingKeys
Schema version follows semver format for future migration handling
All registry items have unique string IDs
forCli array contains CLI identifiers like claude-code, gemini-cli, codex-cli
Metadata fields like downloadCount and rating may be nil for new items
Required Swift minimum version is 5.9 for modern Codable features
constraints: Must use Codable for JSON parsing without third-party dependencies
All types must be Sendable for async/await compatibility
Model types must be value types (structs) not reference types
File must compile with strict concurrency checking enabled
Must not import UIKit or AppKit (models are UI-agnostic)
Total file size must not exceed 500 lines of code
functional_requirements: FR-01: RegistryResponse must decode from JSON containing schemaVersion string, updatedAt ISO8601 date, and arrays for skills/plugins/agents
FR-02: SkillItem must decode all required fields (id, name, description, version, forCli, installUrl) and optional metadata/permissions
FR-03: PluginItem must include all SkillItem fields plus configSchema dictionary for plugin configuration
FR-04: AgentItem must include all SkillItem fields plus requiredSkills array for dependency tracking
FR-05: RegistryMetadata must handle nil values for downloadCount and rating with sensible defaults
FR-06: RegistryPermissions must categorize tools into required vs optional with explanatory descriptions
FR-07: VersionConstraint must support exact, minimum, maximum, and range constraints for CLI compatibility
FR-08: All Identifiable types must use id property as unique identifier for SwiftUI List/ForEach
FR-09: Custom CodingKeys must map snake_case JSON keys to camelCase Swift properties
FR-10: Computed properties must provide formatted strings for UI display without additional transformation
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR-01: JSON decoding of 1000 items must complete in under 100ms on M1 Mac
NFR-02: All model types must be marked Sendable for concurrent access
NFR-03: Memory footprint per item must not exceed 2KB when loaded
NFR-04: File must pass SwiftLint with zero violations
NFR-05: All public APIs must have documentation comments
implementation_steps: Create Blaze/Sources/Registry/Models/ directory if not exists
Create RegistryModels.swift file with file header comment
Define RegistryMetadata struct with author (String), license (String), repositoryUrl (URL?), downloadCount (Int?), rating (Double?), tags ([String]) and CodingKeys enum
Define RegistryPermissions struct with requiredTools ([String]), optionalTools ([String]), fileAccess (FileAccessLevel enum), networkAccess (Bool) and computed permissionSummary property
Define FileAccessLevel enum with none, readOnly, readWrite, full cases and rawValue String conformance
Define VersionConstraint enum with minVersion(String), maxVersion(String), exactVersion(String), range(String,String) cases and Codable conformance via custom init(from:)
Define SkillItem struct conforming to Identifiable, Codable, Sendable with all required fields, nested CodingKeys, and computed displayVersion property
Define PluginItem struct with same base fields as SkillItem plus configSchema ([String:Any]) requiring custom Codable implementation
Define AgentItem struct with same base fields as SkillItem plus requiredSkills ([String]) array
Define RegistryResponse struct as top-level container with schemaVersion (String), updatedAt (Date), skills ([SkillItem]), plugins ([PluginItem]), agents ([AgentItem])
Add JSONDecoder extension or configure decoder with ISO8601 date strategy and snake_case key conversion
Add convenience initializers for creating test fixtures
Add Equatable and Hashable conformance for cache deduplication
Write unit tests in Tests/RegistryModelTests.swift covering all decode paths
Run swift build to verify compilation with strict concurrency
data_model_changes: New RegistryResponse type: top-level container for registry JSON
New SkillItem type: represents a downloadable skill with CLI compatibility
New PluginItem type: represents a downloadable plugin with config schema
New AgentItem type: represents a downloadable agent with skill dependencies
New RegistryMetadata type: author/license/stats metadata for registry items
New RegistryPermissions type: tool and file access requirements
New FileAccessLevel enum: none/readOnly/readWrite/full access levels
New VersionConstraint enum: CLI version compatibility constraints
api_contracts: RegistryResponse.init(from decoder: Decoder) throws - decodes from JSON with ISO8601 dates
SkillItem.id: String - unique identifier for Identifiable conformance
SkillItem.forCli: [String] - array of supported CLI identifiers
PluginItem.configSchema: [String: Any] - plugin configuration schema dictionary
AgentItem.requiredSkills: [String] - array of skill IDs this agent depends on
VersionConstraint.isCompatible(with version: String) -> Bool - checks CLI version compatibility
event_contracts: No runtime events emitted by model layer - models are pure data containers
edge_cases: Empty skills/plugins/agents arrays in registry response must decode without error
Missing optional metadata fields must use nil not crash
Invalid URL strings in repositoryUrl must fail gracefully with nil
Empty forCli array should be valid but log warning
Duplicate IDs across items should be detectable via Set operations
Schema version mismatch should be detectable for migration handling
Extremely long description strings must not cause memory issues
Unicode characters in author names must decode correctly
Future unknown JSON fields must be ignored not cause decode failure
configSchema with nested objects must preserve structure
failure_modes: JSON decode failure due to missing required field - throw DecodingError.keyNotFound
JSON decode failure due to type mismatch - throw DecodingError.typeMismatch
Invalid ISO8601 date format - throw DecodingError.dataCorrupted
URL parsing failure for malformed installUrl - throw DecodingError.dataCorrupted
Memory exhaustion from extremely large response - handled by URLSession limits upstream
rollback_plan: Delete Blaze/Sources/Registry/Models/RegistryModels.swift and Tests/RegistryModelTests.swift. No database migrations or user data affected since models are pure code with no persistence in this atom.
